hero.title: ATLANTIK
hero.subtitle: A short film shot in Asilah

content.paragraph1: Last winter, shapers from Peta Surfboards, Longwinter and Adrokultura gathered in Asilah, the town where our Antik Surf Club project was born and continues to grow. From this meeting, ATLANTIK was created, a film that captures a shared way of understanding board shaping, surfing and life around the ocean.
content.paragraph2: Between the streets of a historic medina and surf sessions, we shared waves with Antik's quiver, as well as ideas, conversations and the same passion for design and craftsmanship. Beyond surfing, this meeting was an opportunity to exchange knowledge, inspire each other and enjoy simply spending time together as friends, united by the same vision of surfing.
content.paragraph3: ATLANTIK is a portrait of friendship, creativity, craftsmanship and the ocean. A journey that highlights handmade work, the time required to create each board and the people who keep an authentic way of doing things alive.
content.final:
And one final thought:
What is made by hand should not be reduced. What is made with soul should not be discounted. What keeps surf culture alive should not be sold halfway. Because Antik is also about culture, respect and commitment to those who believe surfing should remain in the hands of surfers.
